title: From National Curricula to Cultural Awareness: Constructing Open-Ended Culture-Specific Question Answering Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2601.04632v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on many tasks, but their progress remains uneven across languages and cultures, often reflecting values latent in English-centric training data. To enable practical cultural alignment, we propose a scalable approach that leverages national social studies curricula as a foundation for culture-aware supervision. We introduce CuCu, an automated multi-agent LLM framework that transforms national textbook curricula into open-ended, culture-specific question-answer pairs for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Applying CuCu to the Korean national social studies curriculum, we construct KCaQA, comprising 34.1k open-ended QA pairs. Our analyses and training experiments suggest that KCaQA covers culture-specific topics and produces responses grounded in local sociocultural contexts.

translated_title: 从国家课程到文化意识：构建开放式文化特定问答数据集
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在许多任务上表现出色，但其进展在不同语言和文化间仍不均衡，往往反映出以英语为中心的训练数据中的潜在价值观。为了实现实际的文化对齐，我们提出了一种可扩展的方法，利用国家社会科学课程作为文化意识监督的基础。我们引入了CuCu，一个自动化的多智能体LLM框架，将国家教科书课程转化为用于监督微调（SFT）的开放式、文化特定的问答对。将CuCu应用于韩国国家社会科学课程，我们构建了KCaQA，包含34.1k个开放式问答对。我们的分析和训练实验表明，KCaQA覆盖了文化特定的主题，并产生了植根于当地社会文化背景的回应。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用国家课程自动生成文化特定问答数据集的框架，并通过韩国案例验证了其能有效提升模型对本地文化的响应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that automatically generates culture-specific QA datasets from national curricula, validated through a Korean case to enhance models' culturally grounded responses.
